scares.description: There is a loud bang as the housekeeper walks around the house.
There is a loud bang on the window which startles Kristi.
A pan drops in the kitchen.
The pan drops once more, causing Kristi to jump in fright.
The pool cleaning machine jumps out of the water.
Ali’s boyfriend suddenly knocks on the sliding glass door.
A shadow passes over Ali and she suddenly jolts awake.
There is a loud bang on the front door.
All the kitchen doors suddenly fly open while Kristi is in the kitchen. [Video].
Kristi is suddenly pushed to the floor and dragged out of the babies room by an unseen force. [Video].
Kristi lunges at Daniel as he approaches her.
A pan drops on the kitchen bench.
As Daniel moves the camera around the room, Kristi suddenly appears up close and attacks him. [Video].
Katie throws Kristi into the camera.
